description: This Java source file defines the OpenmrsConfigurationFactory class, which extends Log4j2's ConfigurationFactory to provide custom logging configuration handling for the OpenMRS platform. It manages loading configuration files, applying customizations such as in-memory appender setup, and dynamic log level adjustments based on administrative properties.
